title: Intern - Research Assistant
description:
Developing a parametric study of perforated façade designs in Grasshopper and ClimateStudio, varying perforation count,
size, and shape to evaluate trade-offs across daylighting (sDA, ASE, illuminance) and Energy Use Intensity (EUI).
• Testing 1,000+ façade configurations and comparing their EUI against a baseline to quantify the energy impact of each
perforation variant.
• Authored a research paper for publication based on the simulation results.
